title: Make every audit line readable

blocks.text: The security team searches the access audit log by user, by role and by code, and their saved searches match lines such as `k.mensah [billing,support] W+ /invoices/88`. Requests from visitors who are not signed in must be findable with a `-` in the user column. The code column is the operation (`R`, `W` or `D`) followed by `+` when the request was allowed and `-` when it was refused.
`AuditLine.line` already puts the columns together. Write the three `TODO` methods in `src/main/java/practice/AuditLine.java`: `who(user)`, `roles(roles)` and `code(op, outcome)`.

cases.says: a signed-in request's line starts with the user and ends with the path
an anonymous request shows a dash in the user column
the roles column lists the role names separated by commas
the code column is the operation letter followed by the outcome sign

origin.section: `+` Turns Every Operand into Text, and null Becomes the Word "null"

concepts: Two chars added with + are promoted to int and summed before any String joins them.
+ converts each other operand as String.valueOf does: null becomes "null" and an array prints its type and hash.
